settings.label: Domain
settings.meaning: The Kinde domain the app signs users in with: tokens carry it as their issuer, and its keys are at <domain>/.well-known/jwks.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Applications › your back-end app › View details: Domain, such as https://<subdomain>.kinde.com (or your custom domain). Each environment has its own domain: for test, switch to a non-production environment and copy its own.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.meaning: The back-end application the app signs users in through. Tokens issued to it name it in azp.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Applications › your back-end app › View details: Client ID. A non-production environment's application has its own.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.meaning: Authenticates the back-end application when it exchanges a sign-in code, refreshes or revokes tokens.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Applications › your back-end app › View details: Client secret. A non-production environment's application has its own.

settings.label: Management API client ID
settings.meaning: A machine-to-machine application authorized for the Kinde Management API, for reading, creating and deleting users. Only needed for those calls.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Applications › Add application › Machine to machine, then APIs › Kinde Management API › Authorize, with the scopes read:users, read:user_identities, create:users and delete:users. Its Client ID is on View details.

settings.label: Management API client secret
settings.meaning: The machine-to-machine application's secret, sent with a client_credentials grant for a Management API token.
settings.whereToFind: The machine-to-machine application's View details: Client secret.

operations.name: oauth.exchangeCode
operations.purpose: Exchanges a sign-in's authorization code and PKCE verifier for tokens (grant_type=authorization_code).

operations.name: oauth.refresh
operations.purpose: Exchanges a refresh token for new tokens (grant_type=refresh_token; the offline scope gives one).

operations.name: oauth.revoke
operations.purpose: Revokes a refresh or access token.

operations.name: oauth.clientCredentials
operations.purpose: Gets a Management API token for the machine-to-machine application (grant_type=client_credentials, audience https://<subdomain>.kinde.com/api).

operations.name: users.list
operations.purpose: Lists users, filtered by email address.

operations.name: users.identities
operations.purpose: Lists a user's identities, each with whether it is confirmed: how a user's email is known to be verified.

operations.name: users.create
operations.purpose: Creates a user with an email identity, verified or not.

signature.description: The body is a JWT (Content-Type application/jwt) signed by Kinde with a key from https://<subdomain>.kinde.com/.well-known/jwks (RS256). Verify the signature against that key set, then check the payload's timestamp (ISO 8601) is recent to refuse a replay; event_id identifies the event.
